thought.text: The catch-all `ProxyPass /` intercepts `/xplan-mapserver` before the Alias can handle it (the negative ProxyPass only excludes that one directive, not the catch-all). Let me rewrite the config cleanly using a `ProxyPassMatch` catch-all with a negative lookahead:

reasoning_content:
The negative ProxyPass `!/xplan-mapserver` doesn't work as expected in Apache 2.4 — a negative ProxyPass in the form `ProxyPass !/path target` requires a regex pattern or a path, and the exclusion should be done with `ProxyPassMatch !^/xplan-mapserver(/.*)?$`. In fact, in mod_proxy, the negative form is `ProxyPass !pattern url`, where pattern is a regex. Let me check: according to the docs, "ProxyPass !regex-url url" — this is a regex, so it has to match with the ^...$ pattern. `!/xplan-mapserver` is interpreted as the regex `/xplan-mapserver`, which only matches exactly that path (with no trailing content?) — actually, as a regex, the pattern `/xplan-mapserver` matches a URL that contains it, so /xplan-mapserver?... — the query string is not included in the matching. Hmm, but that 404 is being forwarded to Tomcat — so the negative exclusion didn't work, and the catch-all `ProxyPass /` is matching instead.

Wait — actually, in the case of a negative ProxyPass: "if the pattern is preceded by !, the ProxyPass directive will not be applied if the pattern matches." The pattern is a regex. `/xplan-mapserver` as a regex should match `/xplan-mapserver`. But the 404 is coming from Tomcat (via the catch-all `ProxyPass /`). The order of ProxyPass directives matters — the first matching directive wins. The negative on line 12 excludes it, so it falls through to the next matching ProxyPass, namely the catch-all `ProxyPass / http://127.0.0.1:18081/`. This is proxying to Tomcat, and Tomcat returns the 404.

That's the problem: the catch-all `ProxyPass /` catches everything that isn't explicitly proxied, including /xplan-mapserver. The negative ProxyPass just prevents the negative directive itself from applying, but doesn't exclude it from the catch-all.

I need to make the catch-all not proxy /xplan-mapserver. The way to do it is to make the catch-all a regex that excludes mapserver, or to explicitly add a more specific proxy... actually, the cleanest approach is to keep `ProxyPass /` as the catch-all, but that intercepts everything.

A better approach: remove the catch-all `ProxyPass /` and instead proxy specific contexts. The ROOT webapp (xplan-webpages) is at / on anwendung:18081. But the xPlanBox resources are at / (ROOT) and at /xplan-manager-web, /xplan-validator-web.

Let me rethink. The cleanest way: enumerate all contexts and proxy them, and proxy the ROOT content. But ROOT is served at path / on anwendung.

Options: make the catch-all a regex that excludes /xplan-mapserver:
`ProxyPassMatch "^/(?!xplan-mapserver(/|$)).*$" http://127.0.0.1:18081/`

Let me use ProxyPassMatch with a negative lookahead. Actually, mod_proxy's ProxyPassMatch uses PCRE. Let me do this:
`ProxyPassMatch ^/(?!xplan-mapserver) http://127.0.0.1:18081/`

This proxies everything that starts with / except /xplan-mapserver. The Alias for /xplan-mapserver will then handle the CGI.

Let me restructure:
- Alias /xplan-mapserver (CGI)
- All specific ProxyPass for the tomcat contexts
- Catch-all: ProxyPassMatch ^/(?!xplan-mapserver(/|$))? http://127.0.0.1:18081/

Let me test this. I'll replace the catch-all `ProxyPass /` and `ProxyPassReverse /` with a ProxyPassMatch that excludes xplan-mapserver.

Actually, the negative ProxyPass on line 12 is now useless, so let me remove it. And replace the catch-all.

Let me rewrite the whole config cleanly.

action.command:
cat > /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/xplanbox.conf <<'EOF'
<Directory /opt/mapserver/run>
  Options +ExecCGI
  AllowOverride None
  Require all granted
</Directory>
<VirtualHost *:8080>
  ServerName localhost
  ProxyPreserveHost On
  ProxyRequests Off

  # MapServer WMS raster OWS (CGI) -- must come before catch-all
  Alias /xplan-mapserver /opt/mapserver/run/mapserv-wrapper
  <Files "mapserv-wrapper">
    SetHandler cgi-script
    Require all granted
  </Files>

  # Dienste-Tomcat (18080)
  ProxyPass /xplan-services-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wms/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-services-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wms/
  ProxyPass /xplan-services-wfs-syn/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs-syn/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-services-wfs-syn/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs-syn/
  ProxyPass /xplan-services-wfs/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-services-wfs/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs/
  ProxyPass /xplan-webservices-validator-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-webservices-validator-wms/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-webservices-validator-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-webservices-validator-wms/
  ProxyPass /xplan-webservices-inspireplu/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-webservices-inspireplu/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-webservices-inspireplu/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-webservices-inspireplu/

  # API-Tomcat (18082)
  ProxyPass /xplan-manager-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-manager-api/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-manager-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-manager-api/
  ProxyPass /xplan-validator-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-validator-api/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-validator-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-validator-api/
  ProxyPass /xplan-dokumente-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-dokumente-api/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-dokumente-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-dokumente-api/

  # Anwendungs-Tomcat (18081) - manager/validator web + ROOT webpages
  ProxyPass /xplan-manager-web/ http://127.0.0.1:18081/xplan-manager-web/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-manager-web/ http://127.0.0.1:18081/xplan-manager-web/
  ProxyPass /xplan-validator-web/ http://127.0.0.1:18081/xplan-validator-web/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-validator-web/ http://127.0.0.1:18081/xplan-validator-web/
  # catch-all -> Anwendungs-Tomcat ROOT (xplan-webpages), excluding /xplan-mapserver
  ProxyPassMatch "^/(?!xplan-mapserver(/|$)).*$" "http://127.0.0.1:18081/"
  ProxyPassReverse "^/(?!xplan-mapserver(/|$)).*$" "http://127.0.0.1:18081/"

  ErrorLog ${APACHE_LOG_DIR}/xplanbox-error.log
  CustomLog ${APACHE_LOG_DIR}/xplanbox-access.log combined
</VirtualHost>
EOF
apache2ctl configtest 2>&1 | tail -1 && apache2ctl -k restart >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4
echo "=== MapServer via Apache ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "mapserver: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1"; head -c 120 /tmp/o; echo
echo "=== ROOT via Apache ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "root: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/"
